description.en: NPCs answer what was actually said in their own register. A small speech mask describes flexible habits; three varied exchanges illustrate natural replies, not compulsory catchphrases, refusals or short sentences. Source-authored speech stands. A reviewed background lane fills missing cards, while an explicit campaign upgrade archives older generated cards and regenerates current or met people. Examples are never a script to recite.

actor_profile_keys.label: mask
actor_profile_keys.ask: one line, only when the book prints this person's speech: their register and flexible habits of address, wording or sentence endings, without requiring a catchphrase or a marker in every sentence

actor_profile_keys.label: in exchange
actor_profile_keys.ask: up to three exchanges the book prints, each on one line: what someone says to this person, an arrow, what this person says back
